title: The Halloween Party
content:
It is Halloween night.

Emma is at a small party.

There is one pumpkin on the table.

There are three candles next to the pumpkin.

Emma wears a witch costume.

Her friends wear different costumes.

One friend is a ghost, and two friends are vampires.

Outside, there is a black cat in the garden.

The cat looks at the children.

The children have bags for candy.

There are many houses on the street, and the children visit the houses together.

At the end of the night, Emma has one big bag of candies.

Her friends have many candies too.

It is a fun Halloween night!
